config.description: Monthly: hold the 25 non-ETF names closest to their 52-week high (close ÷ 252-session high ≥ 0.85), equal weight; a holding is kept while its ratio stays ≥ 0.75 and it remains in the top 50.

config.kill_criterion: Trails ew_benchmark by >15% over any rolling 6 months, or max drawdown exceeds 35%.
